setupHint: This password encrypts the credentials of this account. It does not go to the server — not even as a hash. Whoever loses it can only get back in with one of the recovery codes shown next.
mismatch: The two entries are not the same.
unlockHint: To unlock the credentials. If it is wrong, decryption fails — the server notices nothing of this and cannot check it either.
recoverHint: One of the recovery codes from the setup. Upper and lower case and the hyphens do not matter.
recoverReplaces: The whole set of codes is replaced: every old one opened the same door.
changeHint: The key pair stays the same — only the wrapping is new. All projects therefore stay readable, for the others too.
codesWarning: These codes are shown {onlyNow}. The server does not know them and cannot send them again. Each of them unlocks the credentials of this account — keep them where you would otherwise keep a key.
copyAll: Copy all codes to the clipboard
codesStored: I have stored the codes in a safe place.
working: The recovery codes are being created. Each one is encrypted separately — that takes a moment and is meant to: exactly this computing time stands between a guessed password and your credentials.
forgot: Forgot master password? Redeem a recovery code
